title: Add a visual supplier aging evidence field designer
description: On the existing supplier aging page, purchasing user selects finite fields and filters, previews the current authorized page and exports selected-column CSV. Keep static view. Development only; reuse existing SupplierReconciliationAging.ForQueryAsync evidence, current-user purchase-order menu authorization and HTTP audit. Preserve explicit due-date unknowns, separate currencies, draft/void history and invalid/unknown allocation evidence. Fail closed on missing permission, invalid requests or source failures. No payment approval, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Existing page exposes finite field chooser and passes only catalog keys and current filters to ERP-140 bounded preview.
Designer renders selected evidence columns with unknown due date/remaining and separate currencies plus loading, empty, permission and network states.
Selected-column current-page CSV preserves unknown values and escapes formula-leading text; Node tests cover selection, paging, rendering, CSV and failures; document workflow.
